name: Jenkins Console
description: Manage Jenkins jobs, builds, console output, queue and nodes inside DBX, with stage view and MCP tools for AI clients.

versions.releaseNotes: First public release: jobs, builds and console output, queue and nodes, Jenkins Views grouping, pipeline stage view, job/view create, edit and delete, and 10 MCP tools.

Console log list with line numbers, ANSI colours, problems-only filter, search with match navigation, fullscreen and per-line copy. Adds a build executor panel and in-app confirmation dialogs for stop/cancel, and fixes log area clipping and scroll-to-bottom.

zh-CN.name: Jenkins 管理台
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 内管理 Jenkins 任务、构建、控制台日志、队列与节点，支持阶段视图与面向 AI 客户端的 MCP 工具。
